# seatsio

**Tag**: web, cli

## 简介

This is the official Ruby client library for the Seats.io V2 REST API

- 主页: http://seats.io
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/seatsio/53.4.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/seatsio
